subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'no substitution required'.

Besides the atmospheric changes that make us sweat, (hormonal or emotional stimulus can also cause sweating).

options.text: hormonal and emotional stimuli also causes sweating
hormonal or emotional stimuli can also cause sweating
hormonal or emotional stimulus also causing sweating

solution:
The correct answer is "**hormonal or emotional stimuli can also cause sweating**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence uses "stimulus" as a singular noun, which is incorrect as it should be "stimuli" in this context. 
 
• **The correct option uses "stimuli" and also correctly uses "or" to show that either hormonal or emotional factors can cause sweating.**
 
• Option 1 is incorrect as it uses "and" instead of "or".
 
• Option 4 is incorrect as it uses "also causing" instead of "can also cause".
 
• Thus, the correct sentence will be:
 
 
• Besides the atmospheric changes that make us sweat, hormonal or emotional stimuli can also cause sweating.
 
 

​​​Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.
